
```{r}
train <- dplyr::inner_join(x_train, y_train, by = c("X" = "...1"))
test <- dplyr::inner_join(x_test, y_test, by = "...1")

train <- train %>% select(-"X")
test <- test %>% select(-"...1")

data <- rbind(train, test)

data$confederation_code <- as.factor(data$confederation_code)
data$genderfactor <- as.factor(data$genderfactor)
```

```{r}
data$rowindicator <- 1:nrow(data)
train <- stratified(data, c("confederation_code", "genderfactor"), 0.8)
test <- data[!(data$rowindicator %in% train$rowindicator),]
train <- train %>% select(-rowindicator)
test <- test %>% select(-rowindicator)
```


```{r}

```


```{r}
regressionTreeMatrix <- function(traindata, testdata, numtrees, mtrys) {
  outputMatrix <- matrix(, nrow = length(numtrees), ncol = length(mtrys))
  rownames(outputMatrix) <- paste0("n", numtrees)
  colnames(outputMatrix) <- paste0("m", mtrys)
  for(i in 1:length(numtrees)) {
    for(j in 1:length(mtrys)) {
      ntree_i <- numtrees[i]
      mtry_j <- mtrys[j]
      set.seed(501322)
      rf <- randomForest(avg_goals ~ ., data = traindata, mtry = mtry_j,
                            importance = TRUE, ntree = ntree_i)
      yhat <- predict(rf, newdata = testdata)
      mse <- mean((yhat - testdata$avg_goals)^2)
      outputMatrix[i,j] <- mse
    }
  }
  return(outputMatrix)
}

finalMatrix <- regressionTreeMatrix(train, test, c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500), c(1:11))
```

```{r}
finalMatrix
```

```{r}
regressionTreeMatrix_boost <- function(traindata, testdata, numtrees, learningrates) {
  outputMatrix <- matrix(, nrow = length(numtrees), ncol = length(learningrates))
  rownames(outputMatrix) <- paste0("n", numtrees)
  colnames(outputMatrix) <- paste0("l", learningrates)
  for(i in 1:length(numtrees)) {
    for(j in 1:length(learningrates)) {
      ntree_i <- numtrees[i]
      learningrate_j <- learningrates[j]
      set.seed(501322)
      boost <- gbm(avg_goals ~ ., data = traindata, distribution =
                     "gaussian", n.trees = ntree_i, shrinkage = 
                     learningrate_j)
      yhat <- predict(boost, newdata = testdata)
      mse <- mean((yhat - testdata$avg_goals)^2)
      outputMatrix[i,j] <- mse
    }
  }
  return(outputMatrix)
}

finalMatrix_boost <- regressionTreeMatrix_boost(train, test, c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500), c(0.0001, 0.0005, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.5, 1))
```

```{r}

longData_boost<-longData_boost[longData_boost$value!=0,]

ggplot(longData_boost, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1)) + 
  geom_raster(aes(fill=value)) + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low="grey90", high="red") +
  labs(x="learningrate", y="ntree", title="Matrix") +
  theme_bw() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=9, angle=0, vjust=0.3),
                     axis.text.y=element_text(size=9),
                     plot.title=element_text(size=11))
```


```{r}
models <- c(rep("Basic (11, 500)" , 2) , rep("Automatic (3, 500)" , 2) , rep("Optimal RF (5, 25)" , 2) , rep("Optimal Boost (0.05, 100)" , 2))
tt <- rep(c("train", "test") , 4)
mse <- c(0.2209766, 0.1909169, 0.1961546, 0.194267, 0.224711, 0.1723572, 0.1223594, 0.1573239)
mse_data <- data.frame(models, tt, mse)

ggplot(mse_data, aes(fill=tt, y=mse, x=models)) +
  geom_bar(position="dodge", stat="identity") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5))
```

```{r}
data_prepared$confederation_code <- as.factor(data_prepared$confederation_code)
data_prepared$genderfactor <- as.factor(data_prepared$genderfactor)

data_noNA$predicted_boost <- predict(boost_optimal, newdata = data_prepared)

```


```{r}
plot_data <- data.frame(
  actual = data_noNA$avg_goals,
  predicted_boost = data_noNA$predicted_boost,
  predicted_bag = data_noNA$predicted_bag,
  country = data_noNA$Country,
  confederation = data_noNA$confederation_code
)

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = predicted_bag, y = actual, color = confederation, label = country)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Optimal Random Forest Output (Train + Test)",
       x = "Predicted Avg. Goals",
       y = "Actual Avg. Goals",
       color = "Confederation")

ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = predicted_boost, y = actual, color = confederation, label = country)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Optimal Boost Output (Train + Test)",
       x = "Predicted Avg. Goals",
       y = "Actual Avg. Goals",
       color = "Confederation")
```
